# dsh-share-import

Import a **public chat share link** into DeepSeek Harness (DSH) as a
real, resumable session inside
a workspace you pick. Supported sources:

- **DeepSeek** — `https://chat.deepseek.com/share/<id>`
- **Doubao (豆包)** — `https://www.doubao.com/
thread/<id>` (also without `www`)
The imported conversation is **history only**: no message is sent, nothing is generated, no turn is

left
open. Open the session and it is already a finished conversation — your next prompt simply cont

inues from
that history.
中文说明
## Features

- **Zero credentials.** DeepSeek is read through its public share endpoint
(`https://chat.deepseek.c

om/api/v0/share/content?share_id=…`). Doubao is read through its public JSON
snapshot endpoints (reg

ular ids via `POST /alice/message/share/get`, mobile `x…` ids via
`POST /im/message/share/get`), fal

ling back to the server-rendered share page. No login, no token, no
headless browser.
- **Pick the t

arget workspace.** The panel lists the workspaces of your DSH instance and writes the session
into t

he one you choose.
- **Static import.** Writes a v4 session event log directly: `session/title → tur

n/start → step/start →
user/message → assistant/message → step/end → turn/end → session/end-seed`. N

othing is scheduled.
- **Duplicate guard.** Re-importing the same share is blocked by default (`ALRE

ADY_IMPORTED`), with an
explicit "import as a new session anyway" path in the panel.
- **Bilingual U

I.** English and Chinese strings follow the DSH UI language.
- **Optional sidebar entry.** A switch

in Settings keeps the nav entry visible or hidden; the state lives in
`localStorage` of the current

browser.
- **Honest limits.** Doubao shares import text only; images and videos have no textual body

and become a
single placeholder line. A share that the page itself declares lazy-loaded is reported

as `SHARE_LAZY`
instead of importing a truncated conversation.
## Screenshot
The import panel, opened from the sidebar entry or from Settings → **Share import**:
## Requirements
- DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** (the version this plugin is written and tested against) with the `web` profile.

- Node.js **≥ 20** on the machine that runs `dsh web`.
- A public share link that is readable witho
ut logging in. Private/expired shares cannot be imported.
The host half uses DSH services that are not a stable public API; a DSH upgrade may require an updat
t half uses DSH services that are not a stable public API; a DSH upgrade may require an update here.

### From GitHub (recommended)

From npm (once published):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### From a local checkout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh plugin add` also appends `dsh-share-import` to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`; the `insert

` in
`cordis.patch.yml` mounts the plugin. Then:
- **Client half** — just refresh the page (the browser bundle is re-served; the host picks the new b

undle
up within ~500 ms).
- **Host half** — **restart the process that runs `dsh web`**. DSH 0.2.1-r

c.2 has no in-process code reload
for host plugin modules, so editing `lib/*.js` and refreshing does
nothing until the restart.
## What gets imported
| Item | Behaviour |
| Content | Question/answer prose only. Reasoning traces, web-search results, opened pages and citat

ion markers are dropped. |
| DeepSeek shares | Public JSON share endpoint → message fragments (`REQU

EST` / `RESPONSE`). |
| Doubao shares | Public JSON snapshot first (regular ids `/alice/message/shar
e/get`, `x…` mobile ids `/im/message/share/get`), then the share page's SSR `data-fn-args` payload (
`share_info` + `message_snapshot`). Only text blocks (`block_type 10000`) become messages; images (`
2074`) and rich media/video (`10050`) have no text, so a message that is *only* media becomes one pl
aceholder line (`（这条消息在豆包网页端只有图片或视频，没有文字）`). If the page declares lazy loading and the snapshot has

no messages, the import fails with `SHARE_LAZY` instead of writing a partial session. |
| Trailing q

uestion without an answer | Dropped, so no turn is left open. |
| Title | First user question, trunc
ated to 80 bytes on a UTF-8 boundary. Doubao shares that start with an assistant message use the sha

re title instead. |
| Generation | Nothing is generated. The imported turn is already complete. |
|

Sandbox / plan mode | Not touched. The session uses your current default access mode. |
| Dedup jour
nal | `$DSH_HOME/share-import/index.json`, keyed by `source:id` (`deepseek:<id>` / `doubao:<id>`), v

alue `{sessionId,title,importedAt}`. |
| Session file | `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<workspace>/<sessionId>/
session.v4.jsonl.zstd`, written by `sessionPersistence` and read back for verification. |
## Privacy and security
- The plugin contacts only the two public share domains (`chat.deepseek.com`, `www.doubao.com`) with

plain
anonymous GET/POST requests. It never reads cookies, tokens or DSH credentials.
- It writes e

xactly two things: the v4 session under the chosen workspace, and the dedup journal above.
No teleme

try, no background requests, no analytics.
- The URLs it fetches are built from validated ids only;

redirects are refused (`redirect: 'error'`) and
response bodies are size-capped.
- Imported content

is whatever the share contains — treat it as untrusted text, exactly like a pasted
conversation.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Three POST routes are registered on the DSH web server (`/__dsh-share-import/{workspaces,preview,imp

ort}`);
the client bundle calls them through the normal page fetch. Event invariants are asserted by

the smoke
test: `seq` contiguous from 0, `time` non-decreasing, `step/start` before the surface eve

nts it carries,
`surfaceOp` only on surface types, the last event is `session/end-seed`, and no turn

`surfaceOp` only on surface types, the last event is `session/end-seed`, and no turn is left open.
